sections.Profile:
Cabaret, released by Recreativos Franco in 1975, is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine, one of a run of electro-mechanical tables the Madrid company produced through the mid-1970s alongside Impacto and Impact in the same year.

- Manufacturer: Recreativos Franco
- Years made: 1975
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Singing, Dancing, Original Theme, 1970s, Music
